description: This file defines the CommandPool class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages concurrent execution of commands using promises and a pool size limit.

classes.name: CommandPool
classes.description: Manages concurrent execution of AWS commands with configurable pool size and callbacks.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise representing the completion of all commands in the pool.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of commands synchronously, returning aggregated results.

methods.name: getBefore
methods.description: Retrieves the 'before' callback from configuration, ensuring it is callable.

methods.name: cmpCallback
methods.description: Adds or replaces onFulfilled/onRejected callbacks to aggregate results into an array.
